a11y.fact: The trail is a native <nav> landmark labelled "Breadcrumb", containing an ordered list; the label can be overridden through the passthrough props.
The current page is the last list item, a non-link <span> marked aria-current="page".
The "/" separators are aria-hidden so assistive technology does not announce them.
Each ancestor is a native <a>, so keyboard focus, the focus ring and activation are the browser's own; no focus style is overridden.
